brand.name: HydroSunset
brand.voice: Active. Warm. Reliable. Speaks to people who move — hikers, gym-goers, commuters, anyone who refuses to be dehydrated. Grounded confidence, not hype.

product.name: Summit 32
hero_features: 32 oz capacity — one fill covers a full workout
Powder-coated matte grip — no slip, no sweat
Flip-top sport lid with one-hand operation
Paracord carry loop — clip it, carry it, go

icps.label: Weekend Trail Hiker
pain_points: Water gets warm an hour into a summer hike
Plastic bottles crack in backpack side pockets
Can't drink one-handed on steep descents
Tired of bottles that sweat and soak everything in the bag

copy.headline:
STILL ICE COLD
AT THE SUMMIT
copy.subline:
Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps your water
cold for 24 hours — even on the hottest trails.

visual_treatment.background_mood: A dramatic water splash scene — the bottle standing upright in the center as a massive burst of crystal-clear water erupts around it from all sides. Frozen water droplets suspended mid-air. Cool blue and aqua tones mixing with warm orange reflections from the bottle. Dark moody background behind the splash so the water and bottle pop. Studio-lit splash photography. Darker at top and bottom edges for text contrast.

copy.headline:
ONE FILL.

32 ounces of ice-cold water that stays cold

visual_treatment.background_mood: An explosive water splash scene with the bottle at the center — water blasting upward and outward in a powerful dynamic burst.
